title: [AI-BIO-01] Structure-Guided Allosteric JAK2 V617F JH2 Mutant-Selective Inhibitor / PROTAC Degrader Design
wet_lab_execution_model: Zero internal wet lab required for hit-to-lead: pair in-silico MD/free-energy perturbation (FEP+) & generative pocket design on PDB 4FVR/6E2Q/8BAK/8EX2 (V617F JH2) vs 4FVP (WT JH2) with fee-for-service biochemical binding panels (Eurofins DiscoverX / Reaction Biology JH2 vs JH1 selectivity assays + isogenic Ba/F3 EPOR V617F vs WT cell lines).
problem_wedge: All 4 FDA-approved JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, fedratinib, pacritinib, momelotinib) are Type I ATP-competitive binders of the conserved JH1 catalytic domain, inhibiting wild-type JAK2 alongside mutant JAK2 V617F. This causes dose-limiting anemia and thrombocytopenia, induces JAK2 heterodimer persistence, fails to eradicate mutant HSC clones, and leads to ~50% ruxolitinib discontinuation within 3 years (median post-discontinuation OS: 11-23 months). While first-gen reversible JH2 binders (INCB160058, NCT06313593) and Type II DFG-out binders (AJ1-11095, NCT06343805) just entered Phase 1, catalytic JH2-selective degraders (PROTACs/molecular glues) that eliminate scaffolding remain wide open.
solution_blueprint: Design next-generation small-molecule allosteric binders or V617F-selective heterobifunctional degraders (PROTACs recruiting CRBN/VHL/DCAF) targeting the mutated JH2 pseudokinase pocket (p.Val617Phe aromatic pi-stacking rearrangement) achieving >50x selectivity over wild-type JAK2/JAK1/TYK2 to enable catalytic clonal clearance without myelosuppression.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: ~15,000-25,000 US Myelofibrosis patients (~50-60% JAK2 V617F+) + >150,000 Polycythemia Vera (>95% JAK2 V617F+) & Essential Thrombocythemia expansion; Ruxolitinib exceeds $4.5B/yr global revenue.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Preclinical/Phase 1 mutant-selective kinase assets transact for $80M-$400M+ upfront/option packages (benchmarks: Prelude-Incyte INCB160058 alliance, Ajax Therapeutics AJ1-11095); single-asset MF biotechs exit at $1.7B-$2.9B.

regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation (7-yr exclusivity, 100% waiver of FY2026 $4,682,003 PDUFA filing fee, 25% QCTE tax credit) + Fast Track in post-ruxolitinib MF.
first_90_days_milestones: Benchmark structural dynamics and exit vectors across PDB 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK, and 8EX2 (JAK2 V617F JH2) vs PDB 4FVP (WT JH2) against ChEMBL CHEMBL2971 ligands.
Run virtual screen / generative ternary-complex design optimizing JH2-V617F vs JH2-WT delta-delta-G selectivity and non-JH1 hinge binding.
Order 30-50 custom/Make-on-Demand analogs or linker-warhead pairs ($25K-$45K) and screen in outsourced JH2-WT vs JH2-V617F TR-FRET competition and HiBiT degradation assays.
Submit NCI SBIR Phase I ($400K) and MPN Research Foundation MPN Challenge ($250K) LOI with initial selectivity curves.

title: [AI-BIO-02] Composite Surrogate Endpoint & AI Digital Pathology Platform Solving the Phase 3 SVR35/TSS50 Crisis
wet_lab_execution_model: 100% software / computational pathology & digital biomarker platform using digitized bone marrow H&E/reticulin WSIs, NGS VAF kinetics, and high-frequency wearable/ePRO feeds.
problem_wedge: Between 2024 and 2026, three major frontline Phase 3 combination trials—TRANSFORM-1 (navitoclax, NCT04472598), MANIFEST-2 (pelabresib, NCT04603495), and SENTRY (selinexor, NCT04562389)—hit Spleen Volume Reduction (SVR35) yet missed strict Total Symptom Score (TSS50) statistical cutoffs due to noisy diary scores, while IMpactMF (imetelstat, NCT04576156) failed on Overall Survival in Oct 2026. Meanwhile, manual WHO marrow fibrosis grading (MF-0 to MF-3) has 30-40% inter-pathologist discordance.
solution_blueprint: Build a regulatory-grade composite disease-modification biomarker platform combining foundation-model reticulin/megakaryocyte WSI morphometry, longitudinal JAK2 V617F / HMR VAF clearance, and passive wearable + micro-sampled MF-SAF v4.0 ePROs—aligned with the FDA Rare Disease Endpoint Advancement (RDEA) program.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $40,000 - $150,000 (academic biobank DUA + pathology vision encoder fine-tuning + hematopathologist adjudication)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: 30+ active Phase 1-3 Myelofibrosis clinical trials globally spending $30M-$120M per trial; B2B SaaS biopharma endpoint & central pathology contracts average $300K-$1.5M per trial.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: High-margin translational AI biomarker & trial-rescue SaaS (PathAI / Tempus hematology model) generating immediate biopharma contract revenue prior to FDA SaMD clearance.

regulatory_pathway: Launch as RUO centralized clinical trial exploratory/secondary endpoint -> FDA Biomarker Qualification / RDEA Pilot -> CLIA / FDA 510(k) SaMD.
first_90_days_milestones: Execute Data Use Agreement (DUA) with 1-2 academic MPN centers of excellence (200-400 longitudinal marrow biopsy WSIs + MIPSS70+ v2.0 outcomes).
Fine-tune open pathology foundation encoders on megakaryocyte clustering topology and continuous reticulin/collagen morphometry.
Demonstrate superior prediction of progression-free survival and ruxolitinib failure vs coarse manual MF-0/3 grading.
Pitch translational biomarker teams at clinical-stage MPN sponsors (Incyte, Kartos, Karyopharm, Sumitomo, Ajax) as a Phase 2/3 endpoint enrichment engine.

title: [AI-BIO-03] Single-Cell Megakaryocyte-Stroma Drug Repurposing Screen for Direct Bone Marrow Fibrosis Reversal
wet_lab_execution_model: Computational single-cell perturbation modeling across human MF scRNA-seq atlases + outsourced validation in primary MPN CD34+ megakaryocyte / stromal co-cultures or 3D marrow organoids via academic core/CRO.
problem_wedge: Zero FDA-approved drugs reverse established bone marrow reticulin/collagen fibrosis. Even under JAK inhibition, aberrant megakaryocytes secrete S100A8/A9 alarmins, TGF-beta1/3, CXCL4, and PDGF, locking LepR+/GLI1+ mesenchymal stromal cells in a collagen-producing myofibroblast state.
solution_blueprint: Pair human MF CD34+/megakaryocyte scRNA-seq (GSE144568) and mesenchymal stromal scRNA-seq (GSE156644) with drug-repurposing perturbation graphs (Every Cure / LINCS / Tahoe-100M) to identify non-myelosuppressive clinical-stage or generic oral compounds that collapse the S100A8/A9-GLI1-TGFb fibrotic loop as an orthogonal add-on to any JAK inhibitor.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $65,000 - $180,000 (computational ranking + 12-compound combo screen in patient-derived CD34+/stromal co-cultures via academic core)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: 505(b)(2) reformulation or fixed-dose combination with 7-year FDA Orphan Drug exclusivity cuts pre-IND cost by 60-75% and addresses 100% of MF genotypes (JAK2+, CALR+, MPL+, triple-negative).
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Fastest path to Investigator-Initiated Trial (IIT) Phase 1b/2 proof-of-concept in ruxolitinib suboptimal responders (<$2.5M via MPNRF Challenge + FDA Orphan Products Grant).

regulatory_pathway: FDA 505(b)(2) + Orphan Drug Designation leveraging existing human safety packages of repurposed/shelved clinical compounds.
first_90_days_milestones: Reconstruct ligand-receptor fibrotic circuits (CellChat/NicheNet) between MF megakaryocytes (GSE144568) and LepR+/GLI1+ stromal myofibroblasts (GSE156644).
Cross-score candidate transcriptional reversals against marrow-penetrant clinical-stage or generic compounds with zero platelet/hemoglobin toxicity.
Execute a $45K-$75K Sponsored Research Agreement with an academic MPN lab to test top 8 combinations in human MF stromal co-cultures.
File provisional method-of-use and synergistic combination patents prior to publication.

title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-01] Regulatory-Grade RWE External Control Arm & No-Washout Clinical Trial Matching Engine
wet_lab_execution_model: Zero wet lab; FHIR/EHR patient-authorized data sync complementary to existing registries (MPN PROGRESSion Registry NCT07362225, HealthTree) + automated community oncology trial routing.
problem_wedge: Median OS after ruxolitinib discontinuation is 11-23 months, yet >70% of US MF patients are treated in generalist community clinics. Worse, patients refuse salvage trials that require a 14-28 day ruxolitinib washout ('washout terror' from cytokine rebound), while sponsors pay $30K-$60K/patient recruiting Best-Available-Therapy control arms.
solution_blueprint: Build a FHIR-native longitudinal companion and automated trial-matching engine that tracks CBC/transfusion velocity, MIPSS70+ v2.0 NGS risk, and RR6 ruxolitinib-failure criteria—specifically filtering for add-on / overlap-bridging trials (e.g., POIESIS NCT06479135) while licensing FDA-auditable External Control Arms (ECAs) to Phase 2/3 sponsors.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $35,000 - $120,000 (FHIR EHR connector + ClinicalTrials.gov v2 eligibility parser + compensated patient advisory co-design)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Rare hematology trial recruitment commands $8,000-$25,000 per enrolled/screened patient, plus $500K-$2M+ per biopharma External Control Arm licensing contract.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Capital-efficient rare-disease RWE & trial-acceleration model (Citizen Health / PicnicHealth / HealthTree benchmark) reaching cash-flow positivity on 3-5 sponsor contracts.

regulatory_pathway: IRB-approved patient-mediated HIPAA Right-of-Access platform aligned with FDA Guidance on Real-World Data (RWD) External Control Arms.
first_90_days_milestones: Parse structured inclusion/exclusion criteria (platelets, Hb, prior JAKi washout vs add-on rules, TP53/JAK2 status) across all active MF trials via ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.
Partner transparently with MPN Research Foundation, Blood Cancer United CTSC, or HealthTree for 15 compensated ($150/hr) patient & community-oncologist workflow interviews.
Ship free FHIR lab/transfusion/VAF trend visualizer + 1-page 'Oncologist Trial Brief' highlighting zero-washout add-on trials.
Close pilot recruitment or RWE feasibility contract with 1-2 Phase 2 MPN biotech sponsors.

title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-02] AI Allo-HSCT Timing, Cytopenia Switch & Shared-Decision Concierge ('The 10% to 35% Bridge')
wet_lab_execution_model: Pure care-delivery, clinical decision support (CDS), and reimbursed Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM/CCM) infrastructure.
problem_wedge: Allogeneic stem cell transplant (allo-HSCT) is the ONLY curative therapy for MF (5-yr OS ~50-60%), yet <10-15% of eligible patients ever receive it. Community oncologists lack molecularly calibrated timing tools (balancing MIPSS70+ v2.0 progression risk against 20-36% transplant NRM) and struggle to titrate switches across ruxolitinib, momelotinib (anemia), and pacritinib (platelets <50k).
solution_blueprint: Deploy a reimbursed RTM/CCM symptom & transfusion monitoring service paired with transparent NCCN/MIPSS70+/MTSS clinical decision support and BMT Center-of-Excellence referral navigation—catching high-molecular-risk (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, TP53) patients in the optimal pre-blast transplant window.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $150,000 - $400,000 (MPN-SAF ePRO + MIPSS70+/MTSS CDS workflow + pilot with 2 academic BMT centers and regional oncology clinics)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Prevents $100K-$250K/yr avoidable transfusion/splenomegaly admissions and blast-phase crises; monetizes via Medicare RTM/PCM CPT codes + BMT Center-of-Excellence value contracts.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Scalable across all Myeloproliferative Neoplasms (>300,000 US PV/ET/MF patients) and MDS (~60,000 US patients).

regulatory_pathway: Non-device Clinical Decision Support (CDS) exemption under 21st Century Cures Act (displaying transparent NCCN/MIPSS70+/MTSS clinical logic to clinicians) + HIPAA BAA.
first_90_days_milestones: Encode transparent RR6 (Response to Ruxolitinib after 6 months), MIPSS70+ v2.0, and MTSS (Myelofibrosis Transplant Scoring System) calculators with longitudinal EHR lab ingestion.
Co-design shared-decision transplant & JAKi-switch guides with academic BMT directors and MPN Advocacy & Education International.
Apply for NCI Care Delivery SBIR Phase I ($400K) and pilot referral bridge with 1 regional community oncology network.

title: [AI-BIO-04] Subtractive Spatial Multi-Omics: Steroid-Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis as 'Nature's Positive Control' for Fibrosis Reversal
wet_lab_execution_model: Academic pathology biobank FFPE core collaboration (10x Visium HD / Xenium spatial transcriptomics on paired pre/post-rituximab or steroid AIMF biopsies vs non-reversing JAK2+ PMF) + in-silico perturbation target ranking.
problem_wedge: Clinical dogma treats established human bone marrow fibrosis as an irreversible scar because all 4 approved JAK inhibitors fail to clear Grade 2/3 fibrosis in JAK2+ PMF. Yet in Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF—JAK2/CALR/MPL-negative, lupus/autoantibody-driven), reticulin fibrosis completely resolves in 74-80% of patients within 3-12 months of immunosuppression (Gangat et al., Mayo Clinic, Br J Haematol 2024).
solution_blueprint: Contrast spatial and single-cell stromal states of resolving human AIMF marrow against persistent JAK2+ PMF (GSE156644, GSE144568) to isolate the exact myofibroblast de-differentiation and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP-1/8/13 vs TIMP-1 / GLI1 / S100A8/A9) switches—unlocking orthogonal stromal antifibrotics applicable across PMF, IPF, and systemic sclerosis.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $90,000 - $220,000 (archived FFPE core spatial profiling of 15-20 AIMF vs PMF pairs via academic hematopathology DUA + computational target discovery)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Direct stromal fibrosis-reversing therapy addresses 100% of Myelofibrosis genotypes ($2B+ market) with platform expansion into Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis ($4B+).
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: High-value biopharma target-discovery & 505(b)(2)/NCE option deals ($50M-$250M+ upfront/milestones for validated human-in-vivo fibrosis reversal targets).

regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation as an antifibrotic combination backbone in Myelofibrosis + FDA RDEA quantitative pathomics endpoint.
first_90_days_milestones: Execute IRB-exempt archival FFPE tissue collaboration with 1-2 academic hematopathology & rheumatology centers (Mayo / French AIMF consensus criteria).
Generate spatial transcriptomic maps around resolving polyclonal T/B lymphoid aggregates in AIMF vs neoplastic megakaryocyte clusters in JAK2+ PMF.
Rank druggable extracellular/stromal switches separating reversible reticulin remodeling from cross-linked collagen persistence.
File target/repurposing IP and submit MPN Research Foundation Challenge + NIH SBIR Phase I applications.

title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-03] Multi-Modal Biopsy, Iron-Hepcidin & Autoimmune Triage Engine Preventing Catastrophic AIMF vs. Triple-Negative PMF Misdiagnosis
wet_lab_execution_model: 100% software / EHR + digital pathology clinical decision support bridging rheumatology (SLE/UCTD) and community hematology.
problem_wedge: Patients presenting with 'dry tap' marrow fibrosis, severe cytopenias, and massive iron buildup (from RBC transfusions + IL-6/hepcidin macrophage iron trapping) who test negative for JAK2/CALR/MPL face 30-40% diagnostic discordance. Misdiagnosing curable Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) as Triple-Negative PMF subjects patients to ineffective $20K/mo cytopenic JAK inhibitors or 20-35% mortality stem cell transplants instead of curative steroids/rituximab.
solution_blueprint: Build a 21st Century Cures CDS & WSI morphometry triage engine integrating megakaryocyte clustering/atypia vs polyclonal CD3/CD20 lymphoid aggregates, extended myeloid NGS clonality (ASXL1/SRSF2 absence), lupus/ANA/Coombs serology, and ferritin/TSAT/hepcidin kinetics to flag AIMF and transfusional/inflammatory iron overload early.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $45,000 - $130,000 (retrospective WSI + EHR lab validation across 150 triple-negative vs autoimmune fibrotic marrows)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Saves payors $200K-$600K per prevented futile JAKi regimen or inappropriate allo-HSCT; simultaneously enriches true clonal Triple-Negative PMF & ACVR1/hepcidin anemia trials for biopharma sponsors.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Dual revenue from value-based payor/reference-lab hematopathology licensing (Labcorp / Quest / NeoGenomics channel) + biopharma trial-screening contracts.

regulatory_pathway: Transparent clinician-facing CDS under 21st Century Cures Act -> CLIA reference-lab algorithm -> FDA 510(k)/De Novo SaMD.
first_90_days_milestones: Encode Pullarkat / Vergara-Lluri / Mayo 2024 AIMF consensus criteria alongside MIPSS70+ v2.0 and dual iron-overload (TSAT vs ferritin/hepcidin) rules into an open FHIR calculator.
Fine-tune WSI pathology classifier distinguishing scattered normoblastic megakaryocytes + lymphoid islands (AIMF) from cloud-like clustered megakaryocytes (TN-PMF).
Partner with Lupus & MPN advocacy groups to map diagnostic delay between rheumatology and hematology clinics.
